description: Full React + Tailwind v4 + shadcn (new-york) storefront wiring every backend endpoint into real, interactive screens with INR (₹) formatting everywhere, lucide-react icons (no emojis), the specified logo, a sticky nav, and the fully MOCKED Pay / Cancel Payment checkout card. Depends on FEAT-001..005 (shadcn primitives + all APIs). Covers the UI side of every customer journey. Finishes by expanding README.md with setup, scripts, JWT env notes, and the implemented feature list.
steps: Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\frontend\lib\api.ts: a typed fetch client (baseURL '/api') that attaches 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' from the auth store when present, parses JSON, and throws typed errors from the { error } shape. Add a money helper formatINR(paise) -> '₹1,234' used across all screens.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\frontend\context\auth.tsx: an AuthProvider holding { user, token }, persisting the token in localStorage for convenience only, with register/login/logout and a refresh of /api/auth/me on load. Expose a useAuth() hook. Guard protected routes/pages so cart/checkout/orders/addresses require login (redirect to the login page otherwise).

Create a lightweight client router (hash or history based, hand-rolled or a tiny Bun-compatible router — NO Next/Vite) in src/frontend/App.tsx with routes: '/' home, '/catalogue', '/book/:id', '/cart', '/checkout', '/confirmation/:id', '/orders', '/login', '/register'. Render a sticky top nav (logo img from https://kiro.dev/images/community/events/thumbnails/meetup2.svg, search box, Catalogue link, cart icon with item count, and a user dropdown-menu for Orders/Logout or Login/Register) that stays fixed while scrolling. Mount a single <Toaster/> (shadcn sonner). Ensure overlays (Dialog/DropdownMenu/Toaster) use conditional rendering so nothing intercepts clicks when closed.

Build src/frontend/pages/Home.tsx: hero with logo, category entry points (links into the catalogue filtered by category), a 'Recommended for you' section (GET /api/recommendations when logged in, else popular), and for logged-in users an Order History preview with a 'Buy It Again' action (POST /api/orders/:id/buy-again then toast + cart badge update). Covers journey items 1-handoff, 2, 3.

Build src/frontend/pages/Catalogue.tsx: responsive grid of book cards (cover, title, author, publisher, ₹ price, rating) using shadcn Card/Badge; a search box (title/author); filters for category, publisher (list from /api/publishers = 'brands'), and price range; sort by price/title/newest; pagination. All controls hit GET /api/books with the right query params. Covers journey items 5, 6 and base catalogue/search/filter/sort.

Build src/frontend/pages/BookDetail.tsx (GET /api/books/:id): cover, full description, ₹ price, stock status, category, publisher, the tentative DELIVERY DATE, an Add-to-Cart control (POST /api/cart/items with quantity, toast on success, disabled when out of stock), and a Related Products row linking to other detail pages. Covers journey items 7, 8.

Build src/frontend/pages/Cart.tsx (GET /api/cart): line items with cover/title/₹ unit price, quantity stepper (PATCH /api/cart/items/:id), remove (DELETE), line totals and subtotal in ₹, and a 'Proceed to checkout' button (disabled when empty). Cart badge in the nav reflects the server cart. Covers the cart base requirements.

Build src/frontend/pages/Checkout.tsx covering journey items 9, 10, 11: (a) Address step — list saved addresses (GET /api/addresses), select one, and add a new address via a shadcn Dialog (POST /api/addresses); checkout requires a selected address. (b) Gift points — show the user's balance and an input/toggle to redeem points, previewing the discounted ₹ total (client preview only; the server recomputes authoritatively). (c) MOCKED PAYMENT CARD — after an address is chosen and points optionally redeemed, show a card reading 'Payment required' with the amount due in ₹ and two buttons: 'Pay' and 'Cancel Payment'. 'Pay' calls POST /api/orders { address_id, redeem_points } (payment_method defaults to MOCK server-side), and on success navigates to the confirmation screen. 'Cancel Payment' aborts (no order created) and returns to the cart/checkout. NO payment-method selection, NO gateway, no dead buttons.

Build src/frontend/pages/Confirmation.tsx (journey item 12): shown after a successful Pay. Display the EXACT success message 'The product has been purchased successfully and will be delivered soon', the order summary (items, ₹ totals, points redeemed/earned, delivery address snapshot, tentative delivery), and a Cancel Order button that is enabled only within 48h (POST /api/orders/:id/cancel; on backend rejection show the server error toast; on success show cancelled state). It must reflect the server's isCancellable, not a client clock alone.

Build src/frontend/pages/Orders.tsx: the user's order history (GET /api/orders) with status badges, ₹ totals, 'Buy It Again' (POST /orders/:id/buy-again) and, within the 48h window, a Cancel action wired to the same backend endpoint with server-enforced rejection handling. Build Login.tsx and Register.tsx forms (shadcn Input/Label/Button) calling the auth context; on success route home; show field/validation errors from the API.

Verify interactivity requirements across all pages: every button performs a real action (no dead buttons), modals/dropdowns/toasts do not remain over the UI when closed nor intercept clicks when hidden (prefer conditional rendering; use shadcn Dialog/DropdownMenu/Sonner), the nav stays sticky/visible on scroll, lucide-react icons are used (no emojis anywhere), and ₹ formatting is consistent on catalogue, detail, cart, checkout, confirmation, and orders.

Expand c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\README.md: project overview, the Bun-native stack, `bun install` then `bun dev` (ONE command, ONE port) and `bun start`, JWT_SECRET env note with the documented dev fallback, store.sqlite auto-create+seed note, the points->₹ conversion policy, and the full implemented customer-journey feature list (items 1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12) with the mocked-payment behavior and exact success message.
acceptance_criteria: `bun dev` starts ONE server on ONE port serving the React app and the API; the app renders with the specified logo, a sticky nav, lucide-react icons, and no emojis.

A user can register/login/logout; browse the catalogue with search/filter (category + publisher)/sort/pagination; open a book detail showing tentative delivery date and related products; add to cart; manage the per-user cart; select/add a delivery address; optionally redeem gift points; complete the MOCKED Pay flow and see EXACTLY 'The product has been purchased successfully and will be delivered soon'; view order history with Buy It Again; and cancel within 48h (with server-side rejection outside the window surfaced in the UI).
The 'Cancel Payment' button aborts checkout without creating an order and returns to cart/checkout; no button is dead.
All monetary values display in INR with the ₹ symbol consistently across every screen.
`bunx tsc --noEmit` is clean and `bun test` (full suite) passes; README documents setup, scripts, JWT env, and the feature list.
verification: Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and confirm zero type errors across the frontend.
Run the full `bun test` suite and confirm all backend tests still pass.

Boot `bun dev` (or `bun run src/server.ts`) background/bounded; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://localhost:3000/ (expect 200 HTML referencing the bundled JS/CSS). Then manually/scripted drive the API the UI depends on (register -> login -> books -> cart -> address -> order -> confirmation -> cancel) with Invoke-RestMethod to confirm the screens have working endpoints behind them. Stop the server afterward.
Confirm README.md lists the implemented customer-journey features and the mocked-payment success message, and documents the JWT_SECRET env + store.sqlite behavior.
